summary: Move the current-available-memory check (ceiling plus 2 GiB host reserve) from VM creation and stopped edits to starting a VM, so a VM that cannot start yet can still be created; every Core start (manual start, start_after_create, pool autostart) refuses before virsh start with a clear message (BUG-0195). API impact: changed contract — same requests and results; the available-memory refusal moved from vm-create and stopped vm-update to vm-power start and the automatic start after creation, with a new message.

guide.reason: Create VM and VM power guides explain that creation does not need the memory free, and what the start-time refusal means and how to resolve it.

api.reason: API impact: changed contract. vm-create, vm-update and vm-power keep their requests, responses and authorization; the available-memory refusal moved from creation and stopped edits to starts, with the message 'insufficient available memory to start this VM including 2 GiB host reserve'. The Controller's total-memory check is unchanged.

roadmap.reason: Bug fix within existing VM capacity admission.

state.reason: No durable state added; the check reads the VM definition already in Core's managed journal and the host's current memory.

verification.method: go test -race ./internal/vmhost ./internal/agent ./internal/controller with the four new memory tests (including an unresolved larger memory edit) (each failed against the previous code with only the test seams added); python3 scripts/generate_api.py --check. Native: disposable lab Core with 7508 MiB available of 7947 MiB — a 7691 MiB VM was created, its automatic and manual starts were refused with the new message while it stayed shut off, and a 512 MiB VM was created and started.
